headline: Europe Set to Delay Methane Rules by at Least a Year After US Pushback
summary: The European Union is poised to delay its strict methane compliance rules by at least a year following political and industry pushback led by the United States.
why: Methane regulations impose significant compliance costs on oil, gas, and energy infrastructure operators across international supply chains.

impacts.name: Energy Sector
impacts.why: Regulatory delays relieve near-term compliance capital expenditure pressures for energy producers.
